complexity.instructions: How much reasoning does answering this insurance customer ticket require?

criteria.simple: A single fact lookup or classifying what the customer wants.
criteria.moderate: Pulling several specific fields (numbers, dates, ids) out of the message.
criteria.complex: Deciding a claim by applying several policy rules and possibly computing a payout.

needs_calculation.instructions: Does answering this ticket require computing a monetary amount?

missing_information.instructions: Is information the insurer needs to decide this ticket clearly missing?
